info.title: agentSAFE - x402 Smart Contract Audit API
info.description: AI-assisted EVM smart-contract risk screening (Ethereum Mainnet), payable with x402 micro-payments in USDC on Base. This REST endpoint mirrors the audit dispatch of the agentSAFE MCP server (https://github.com/luka1968/agentsafe). Payment is enforced by the x402 protocol (scheme 'exact', x402Version 2): an unpaid request receives HTTP 402 with a base64-encoded 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED' header describing the exact on-chain payment terms. IMPORTANT: AI-assisted risk screening, NOT a formal security audit; findings require human verification before any action. Refund policy: https://agentsafe-three.vercel.app/refund

post.summary: Dispatch an AI smart-contract risk audit (x402-paid)
post.description:
Dispatches a smart-contract audit for a verified Ethereum Mainnet contract. The audit runs asynchronously on a worker; the response returns a task_id for retrieval via the agentSAFE MCP server (tool: check_audit_status).

## Payment required (x402 protocol)
- Price: $3.00 USDC (flat fee; contracts up to 500 source lines - larger contracts must use the MCP endpoint's tiered pricing)
- Scheme: exact
- Network: eip155:8453 (Base Mainnet)
- Asset: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Pay to: 0x03ee35B45382d19b7BDcE1A2B1eD72Aae01c48cc
- Facilitator: https://facilitator.payai.network
- x402Version: 2

Send the payment as a base64-encoded JSON payload in the 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE' request header (x402 v2). Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with the machine-readable requirements in the 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED' response header and response body. Payment is verified before dispatch and settled on-chain after the workflow is successfully dispatched.

202.description: Audit dispatched. Payment settled on-chain; settlement receipt is returned in the 'PAYMENT-RESPONSE' response header.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64-encoded x402 settlement receipt (transaction hash, payer, network).

400.description: Invalid request body or contract address.

402.description: Payment required. The response carries the x402 payment requirements: base64-encoded JSON in the 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED' header and a human-readable copy in the body ($3.00 USDC, eip155:8453 Base Mainnet, payTo 0x03ee35B45382d19b7BDcE1A2B1eD72Aae01c48cc, facilitator https://facilitator.payai.network).

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 PaymentRequirements object (x402Version 2, scheme exact) describing the exact on-chain payment terms.

422.description: Contract not verified on Etherscan, or source exceeds the 500-line flat-fee limit (use the MCP endpoint's tiered pricing for larger contracts; >5000 lines requires enterprise inquiry). No payment is settled in this case.

502.description: Audit worker (GitHub Actions) dispatch failed. Payment verification is never settled on dispatch failure: no funds move.

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 v2 payment: the request carries a base64-encoded signed payment payload in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (scheme 'exact', x402Version 2, USDC on eip155:8453 Base Mainnet). Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with the machine-readable terms in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header. This is the x402 micro-payment paywall - the endpoint is NOT free.

address.description: Ethereum Mainnet contract address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters). The contract must have verified source code on Etherscan.

chain.description: Target chain. Only Ethereum Mainnet is supported.

task_id.description: Audit task identifier; retrieve the report via the agentSAFE MCP tool check_audit_status.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions run id of the audit worker.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment-required body (mirrors the base64 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED' header).

accepts.description: List of acceptable PaymentRequirements (scheme exact, network eip155:8453, asset USDC, amount 3000000, payTo 0x03ee35B45382d19b7BDcE1A2B1eD72Aae01c48cc).

resource.description: The paid resource descriptor (url, description, mimeType).
